app_tagline: [অসমীয়া] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [অসমীয়া] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [অসমীয়া] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [অসমীয়া] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [অসমীয়া] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [অসমীয়া] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [অসমীয়া] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [অসমীয়া] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [অসমীয়া] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [অসমীয়া] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [অসমীয়া] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [অসমীয়া] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [অসমীয়া] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [অসমীয়া] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [অসমীয়া] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [অসমীয়া] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [অসমীয়া] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [অসমীয়া] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [অসমীয়া] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [অসমীয়া] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [অসমীয়া] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [অসমীয়া] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [অসমীয়া] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [অসমীয়া] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [অসমীয়া] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [অসমীয়া] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [অসমীয়া] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [অসমীয়া] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [অসমীয়া] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [as] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [as] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [as] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [as] Type or speak your question for the helper...
